Historical Dramas 'Raja Shivaji' and 'Bahubali: The Torch Bearer' Released on OTT

Two historical productions, 'Raja Shivaji' and 'Bahubali: The Torch Bearer', have been released on over-the-top (OTT) platforms. 'Raja Shivaji' is a film starring Riteish Deshmukh and is based on Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. 'Bahubali: The Torch Bearer' is a documentary. Both releases provide viewers with new content related to historical figures and events.
